name: Human Life
overview: Scripture reveals that human life is uniquely created by God, made in His own image as male and female, and given life through His breath, making each person a living soul (Genesis 1:27; 2:7). Life is sacred and protected, with God condemning the taking of innocent life (Deuteronomy 27:25). Moreover, children are a divine heritage and blessing, valued as a reward from the Lord (Psalms 127:3), and God intimately knows us even before birth, forming us within the womb (Psalms 139:13). Believers find security and refuge under God's care throughout life (Psalms 91:1).
